status: Original terrain transition passes integrated in the GPU preview

implementation.layer_selection: Uses Phase5 native-tested 3x3 minimum-priority choices, unique variation identities, ascending priority, corner closing and the 161-entry rotation/reflection lookup for 33 original masks.
implementation.authored_metadata: Original Terrain base_priority plus Variation ordinal; translation aliases share canonical identity; original texture dimensions and ordered Biome TransitionSets are retained with source hashes.
implementation.transition_selection: 0x7296B0 coordinate hash with signed wrapping integer arithmetic and signed remainders; invalid negative native indices are rejected.
implementation.mask_uv: Dedicated cell-local UV attribute, separately interpolated from diffuse UV. Native 0x72A3B4 scales by (pixels-1)/pixels then adds half-texel offset before original wrap/rotation/reflection. Default TerrainTextureTexelsPerMeter=16 at0x41FA74 and 2m cells give32texels/cell.
implementation.composition: Original 0x72A650 texture stage0 modulates source RGB by diffuse; stage1 preserves RGB and selects mask alpha. Original0x72A280 disables blending for the first pass and enables SRCALPHA/INVSRCALPHA for subsequent default-property passes. These decisions are executed original-code fixtures, not an invented neighbor-color average.
implementation.ordering: Terrain batches are ordered by native priority and retained before object rendering; the object transparency queue cannot reorder terrain passes.
implementation.geometry: Terrain positions, normals, heights, source records and picking remain unchanged. Shared Vertex gains a separate2-float terrain UV; ordinary model/animation paths set it tozero.
implementation.passability_metadata: land/water booleans resolve actual Terrain/MountainTerrain/WaterTerrain template defaults plus authored root overrides. They are distinct from native terrain type and available for separate navigation work.

native_evidence.external_state_sinks: Blend/state fixtures intercept renderer state submission only; stage fixtures record original call arguments. TransitionSet selector stops before resource lookup after the actual native hashed set-pointer load. Matrix cases execute original arithmetic and matrix lookup.

validation.cpu: Original instruction fixtures and Rust selector/UV/state assertions.
validation.gpu: Explicit headless hardware test covers all8 native rotation/reflection selectors and opaque/transparent quadrants, plus half-alpha source-over color mixing.
validation.maps: Headless biome matrix compares new captures with preserved Development05; results in qa-output/phase6/terrain-maps/report.json when complete.
validation.first_crete_observation: Original masks blend19,780 interior cells;892 outermost cells retain fallback. Square grass/crop/mountain edges visibly transition in the captured preview. This is an inspection-render improvement, not proof of native screenshot parity.

remaining_limits: Direct geometry multipass uses the modern renderer's linear/sRGB framebuffer. Original cached offscreen terrain texture quantization, filtering and gamma behavior are not reproduced.
Native final terrain lighting, macro/detail textures, water, shadows and edge/skirt geometry remain incomplete.
Outermost map cells retain the previous single-material draw until native border/ghost-cell reconstruction is proved.
Unresolved variation metadata, ambiguous equal priorities, or conflicting multi-biome TransitionSet lists retain explicit single-material fallback and are counted.
The authored metadata is pinned to recovered original sources; this is not a general runtime terrain TGI editor or hot-reload implementation.
Default power-of-two mask target dimensions are native-bit-checked; arbitrary floating texture-density/FPU configurations are not claimed.
Terrain passes add draw/geometry cost. Concurrent object sorting also changes draw counts; no general performance improvement is claimed from unlike debug/release load timings.
